研究问题：冻结已发表的 PRS 权重后，多分数 TabPFN 能否超越传统单分数: Research questions: With published PRS weights held fixed, can multi-score TabPFN improve on a conventional single-score risk model? The primary evaluation fits each model on the complete training set and predicts the designated development set. Because this development set has already informed earlier research decisions, these results constitute internal development evidence.
一个外部分数 + 年龄 + 性别 + PC1–PC10，使用正则化 Logist: One external score + age + sex + PC1–PC10, fitted with regularized logistic regression; the constant sex column is removed in the female cohort. Both the PRS and C are selected using pooled three-fold AUC within training data, with log loss as the tie-breaker. T2D candidates include 26 input scores and 5 published metascores; CAD selection is repeated across all 7 candidates; breast cancer selection uses 3 candidates.

AUC 衡量排序；Nagelkerke R² 衡量预测概率相对截距模型的似然改善: AUC measures discrimination. Nagelkerke R² measures likelihood improvement over an intercept-only model; it includes covariate contributions, is neither heritability nor the variance explained independently by PRS, and may be negative. Brier score, log loss, and calibration measures are available in the downloadable tables. Probability metrics are evaluated directly on the held-out evaluation set, without refitting a calibrator on that set.
主比较为完整 TabPFN 对 single-best Logistic / D: The primary family comprises full TabPFN versus single-best logistic / Disco: two comparisons × three traits × two metrics, or 12 overall contrasts. We use 2,000 outcome-stratified paired patient bootstrap resamples, reporting nominal 95% and Bonferroni simultaneous intervals. Subgroup intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiplicity. Intervals are conditional on saved predictions and do not capture uncertainty from retraining, historical development choices, or family dependence.
